item.text: I reproduced the failure path and found the implementation defect: the “contact mask” is seeded from movement, retained across frames, and then used to permanently zero both horizontal velocity components. That turns a normal two-axis corner correction into an unrecoverable pin. I’ll keep the reduced post-jetpack collision envelope needed by the narrow opening, but make contacts frame-local and remove the velocity lock.

item.text: The fix is behaving differently from the broken build—the astronaut no longer remains motionless after corner contact—but the protected input tool only permits two simultaneous keys, while this route normally uses diagonal movement plus thrust. I’m validating the same geometry with staged cardinal thrust inputs and adjusting the approach through the slot.

Agent update
events.detail: I reproduced the failure path and found the implementation defect: the “contact mask” is seeded from movement, retained across frames, and then used to permanently zero both horizontal velocity components. That turns a normal two-axis corner correction into an unrecoverable pin. I’ll keep the reduced post-jetpack collision envelope needed by the narrow opening, but make contacts frame-local and remove the velocity lock.
